clue.text: Longed for doctor to enter mixed school

indicators.note: to enter means the doctor word goes inside the school word

parts.note: a co-ed is a co-educational, mixed school
a vet is an animal doctor

explanation.surface: Someone yearned for a medic to join the staff of a co-educational school.
explanation.definitionFit: To covet something is to desire it greatly, a synonym for having longed for it.

clue.text: X lives in Kansas

indicators.note: in means the word for lives sits inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: KS is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Kansas
lives means is, as in 'he is'

explanation.surface: A mysterious person known only as X lives in Kansas.
explanation.walkthrough: X looks like a name or an unknown, but signed at the foot of a letter it means a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: An X written at the end of a letter stands for an affectionate peck.

clue.text: After exam success I am seen in various places

indicators.note: After means the I am piece comes following the exam success piece

parts.note: to pass is to succeed in an exam
I'm is the contraction of I am

explanation.surface: Having passed an exam, a student feels noticed everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Passim is the Latin term used in references meaning throughout or scattered across a text.

clue.text: Disdain for jail-bird with allure

parts.note: a con is a convict, a jail-bird
to allure is to tempt

explanation.surface: Someone feels scorn for a charming prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: Contempt is a feeling of scorn, which is what disdain means.

clue.text: Emphasise that the tally's less than twenty

parts.note: under means less than
a score is twenty

explanation.surface: Someone stresses that a running count has not yet reached twenty.
explanation.definitionFit: To underscore a point is to underline it, giving it stress or emphasis.

clue.text: Study one form of Buddhism when resident

parts.note: a den is a private study room
I is the Roman numeral for one
Zen is a Japanese school of Buddhism

explanation.surface: A resident practises a particular Buddhist tradition while studying.
explanation.definitionFit: A denizen is an inhabitant of a place, someone who lives there.

clue.text: Dejected after All Saints' Day in Serbia

indicators.note: after means the dejected piece is placed following the date piece

parts.note: All Saints' Day falls on 1 November, written NOV I
dejected means sad

explanation.surface: Someone feels low following the November festival of All Saints in Serbia.
explanation.walkthrough: All Saints' Day is 1st November, so NOV plus I (one).
explanation.definitionFit: Novi Sad is Serbia's second city, a place located there.

clue.text: He will eject undesirables from a ball

definitions.meaning: a doorman who throws troublemakers out of a club
in cricket, a short delivery that rears up at the batsman

explanation.surface: A doorman throws unwanted guests out of a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ball' looks like a dance from which guests are ejected; it is a cricket delivery.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a club doorman and a short-pitched cricket delivery go by this name.

clue.text: A real character, this celebrity

definitions.meaning: someone with a striking temperament or makeup
a famous figure in public life

explanation.surface: A famous person is genuinely colourful.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a person's character and a famous figure, such as a TV star.

clue.text: Ten priests resolved to be tenacious

indicators.note: resolved, read as re-solved or worked out afresh, signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A group of ten clergy were determined to stay firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolved' rearranges TEN PRIESTS; it looks like it means determined.
explanation.definitionFit: Persistent and tenacious are synonyms, both meaning refusing to give up.

clue.text: Nefarious mischief maker loses his head

indicators.note: loses his head means the first letter of the mischief maker word is dropped

parts.note: a devil is an imp or troublemaker

explanation.surface: A wicked troublemaker gets beheaded or loses his temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses his head' drops D from DEVIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil and nefarious are synonyms meaning wicked.

clue.text: Retiring agent is furious when given bouquets

indicators.note: Retiring, going back, means the agent word is read backwards

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative or agent
to fume is to be furious

explanation.surface: A shy sales representative is angry when handed flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A bouquet is also a fragrance or scent, which is what these are.

clue.text: Public brawl everyone found priceless

definitions.meaning: an open fight that anyone joins
something costing nothing for all comers

explanation.surface: In a riot, everybody discovers things cost nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A general melee is so named, and the same phrase describes something free of charge to all.

clue.text: Crushed, when cast off by mother

indicators.note: by means placed beside, so the cast-off word follows the mother word

parts.note: Ma is a word for mother
shed means cast off, as a snake does skin

explanation.surface: Someone feels crushed at being rejected by their mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Mashed food has been pulped or pounded, so crushed is a synonym.

clue.text: Patience is quitting the job

definitions.meaning: calm acceptance of what cannot be changed

explanation.surface: It takes forbearance to hand in your notice.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both stoical acceptance and formally giving up a post.

clue.text: Imperilled because of Indian rage

parts.note: Ind is an abbreviation for Indian
anger means rage

explanation.surface: Someone is at risk on account of an Indian's fury.
explanation.definitionFit: To be at risk or under threat is to be imperilled.

clue.text: Mr Kingsley's playing-that's a blessing

parts.note: Ben Kingsley is the actor, and the 's stands for is
on means playing, as an actor on stage

explanation.surface: Ben Kingsley is performing, and that is a treat.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Ben Kingsley is the British actor of Gandhi.
explanation.definitionFit: A benison is an old word for a benediction or blessing.

clue.text: Apprehension about article found in eiderdown

indicators.note: about means the fear word goes around the article

parts.note: apprehension means fear
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Someone is nervous about an item discovered in their duvet.
explanation.walkthrough: An eiderdown is a quilt stuffed with the soft down of eider ducks.
explanation.definitionFit: A down quilt is filled with the soft plumage of eider ducks, so the item is part of its stuffing.

clue.text: Grumbled when worker was given a meal

parts.note: a worker bee is the standard crossword worker
fed means given food

explanation.surface: Someone complained when an employee got lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: To beef is slang for complaining, so beefed means grumbled.

clue.text: What the feller did to be left with unwanted responsibility

definitions.meaning: a feller is one who fells trees, and cutting timber is his work

explanation.surface: A man did something that saddled him with a burden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feller' looks like 'fellow'; it is a tree feller, cutting timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting timber and being saddled with a burden are both expressed by this verb.

clue.text: Active old boy seen in the distance

indicators.note: seen in means the old boy letters appear inside the distance word

parts.note: a mile is a distance

explanation.surface: An energetic former pupil is spotted far away.
explanation.definitionFit: Mobile means able to move about freely, so it is a synonym for active.

clue.text: Seaside amenity ripe for redevelopment

indicators.note: for redevelopment means the letters of ripe are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A seaside attraction is due for rebuilding.
explanation.definitionFit: A seafront jetty with attractions is a classic facility at a British resort.

clue.text: Celebrity with distinct lack of talent?

parts.note: not expresses a lack or absence
ability means talent

explanation.surface: A famous person who is plainly untalented.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface jokes about talentless celebrities; split as 'not ability' it is lack of talent.
explanation.definitionFit: Notability can mean a notable or famous person, a celebrity.

clue.text: Bound to feature in a simple appendix

indicators.note: to feature in means the answer appears within the run of letters

explanation.surface: Something is sure to appear in a basic appendix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' reads as 'certain to'; it means jump.
explanation.definitionFit: A leap is a jump or bound.

clue.text: Business trainees even include an Irish girl

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a business
L stands for learner, so two learners are LL
e'en is the poetic contraction of even

explanation.surface: A firm's apprentices even take on an Irish lass.
explanation.walkthrough: E'EN is the poetic form of 'even'.
explanation.definitionFit: Colleen is the Irish word for a girl or young woman.

clue.text: Advocate giving power to the boss

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics
a leader is a boss

explanation.surface: Someone gives authority to the person in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: An advocate argues a case in court, which is what a pleader does.
